name: Dr. Feelgood's Love Clinic
source:
In DFLC, you play as a visitor to a sexual help clinic called the Love Clinic with a referral from your regular physician. Under the tender care of Dr. Wanda Feelgood, you can explore 6 different sensual paths each with their own unique CG. With unlockable (optional) paths exploring some kinkier content, there's plenty of content for a variety of interests!

[From [url=https://besidesbunny.itch.io/love-clinic]Itch.io[/url]]
